body.purpose: Turkish interface copy and standard controls.

amount.purpose: Tabular financial amounts on wider layouts.

phone-balance.purpose: Distinctive member amounts on phone-width dashboards.

motion.name: balance-rail-settle
motion.purpose: The upper member rail settles into place.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Honors prefers-reduced-motion for animations and transitions.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The filled signal-orange action for the main step on a page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--orange); color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px/1.1 var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #c8522a; background: #c8522a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--orange-deep); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { border-color: #9a8a7e; background: #c7bdb1; color: #39413e; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Quiet Text Action
components.description: An underlined text action beside the primary control.
components.css: .ds-text-action { color: var(--ink); font: 700 15px/1.1 var(--font-body); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--sage); text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text-action:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--ink); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact field for household names, codes, and member names.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Ev adı<input type="text" placeholder="Örn. Çamlık Ev"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink); font: 700 14px/1.2 var(--font-body); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #87978c; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--paper-raised); color: var(--ink); font: 400 16px/1.45 var(--font-body); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #53645c; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ink); outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Household Header
components.description: Keeps the product wordmark, household name, and short invite code together.
components.css: .ds-household-nav { min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-wordmark { font: 700 19px/1.1 var(--font-head); letter-spacing: .04em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-household { min-width: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-household span { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font: 300 18px/1.1 var(--font-head); text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-household code { color: var(--ink); font: 400 12px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-household-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Household Balance Rail
components.description: A connected, two-level ledger diagram for up to five members; names and amounts are illustrative.
components.css: .ds-rail { color: var(--ink); } .ds-rail-upper { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); padding-top: 8px; text-align: center; } .ds-rail-upper::before { position: absolute; top: 4px; right: 12%; left: 12%; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); content: ""; } .ds-terminal { position: relative; min-width: 0; display: grid; justify-items: center; } .ds-terminal i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--paper); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--orange); } .ds-terminal strong { margin-top: 12px; font: 400 17px/1.2 var(--font-body); } .ds-terminal b { margin-top: 2px; font: 700 20px/1.1 var(--font-head); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-terminal small { color: var(--muted); font: 700 14px/1.3 var(--font-head); } .ds-rail-lower { position: relative; width: 76%; max-width: 580px; margin: 9px auto 0; padding-top: 21px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); text-align: center; } .ds-rail-lower::before { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 25%; left: 25%; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); content: ""; } .ds-rail-lower::after { position: absolute; top: -18px; left: 50%; height: 18px; border-left: 1px solid var(--ink); content: ""; }

components.name: Open Expense Row
components.description: A full-width ledger line with description, payer context, and aligned amount.
components.css: .ds-expense-row { min-height: 68px; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-expense-row div { min-width: 0; display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-expense-row strong { font: 500 16px/1.2 var(--font-body); } .ds-expense-row span { color: var(--muted); font: 400 13px/1.25 var(--font-body); } .ds-expense-row > b { font: 700 18px/1.1 var(--font-head); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Suggested Transfer Row
components.description: A proposed person-to-person transfer that remains a suggestion until the household closes the period.
components.css: .ds-transfer-row { min-height: 75px; padding: 11px 3px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 40px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(90px, auto); align-items: center; gap: 13px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-transfer-row div { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-transfer-row strong { font: 700 15px/1.2 var(--font-body); } .ds-transfer-row small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px/1.2 var(--font-body); } .ds-transfer-row > span { color: var(--orange-deep); text-align: center; } .ds-transfer-row > b { font: 700 20px/1.1 var(--font-head); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
Ev Hesap presents the household open account as a readable distribution panel. Matte mineral paper, graphite ink, sage rules, and a restrained signal-orange accent keep totals, people, and expenses connected without interchangeable dashboard cards.

The mobile dashboard is the signature surface: three upper balance terminals and up to two centered lower terminals, each with a name, signed amount, and written balance state. The four-person household keeps breathing room; five members fit without clipping. Expense rows remain a plain ledger and the period closes only by household choice.
keyCharacteristics: Mineral green-gray surfaces, graphite ink, muted sage, and signal orange.
A connected two-level member rail with explicit names, signed balances, and text states.
Tabular financial figures and readable Turkish copy.
Flat, rule-led surfaces with compact rectangular controls.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Orange marks the primary action or a meaningful balance node; deep orange stays a small supporting accent.

rules.name: The Readable Panel Rule
rules.body: A member name, signed amount, and alacaklı/borçlu state remain understandable without color.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces stay flat at rest; labels, borders, and fills show control state.

rules.name: The Aligned Amount Rule
rules.body: Amounts compared in a row share a right edge and use tabular numerals wherever established.

dos: Do preserve the household identity, total, connected balance rail, actions, and open ledger in that reading order.
Do keep each name, signed amount, and written balance state readable without color.
Do align comparable currency figures and use tabular numerals.
Do keep surfaces flat and let spacing, mineral tone, and rules establish their hierarchy.
donts: Don’t turn the interface into interchangeable pastel cards, glass panels, gradient glow, or decorative blobs.
Don’t make the interface look like an electrical repair console or an error alarm.
Don’t encode owing, owed, selected, or error states with color alone.
Don’t promote amber into an active token without a shipped use.
Don’t decorate every section with switch labels, wiring, or equipment marks.
